history.summary: DUPLICATE FLAG: this CSV row (seq 2403) is the same temple as seq 1093 (id shree-jagannath-temple-noida). Kept as a separate file per the duplicate-handling rule. IDENTITY CONFIRMED: the Shree Jagannath Temple at B-10, Jagannath Mandir Marg, Udaigiri-2, Sector 34, Noida. Established by the Shree Jagannath Seva Sangha, it is the focal point of the local Odia community - it stages an annual Ratha Yatra chariot festival and hosts cultural programs promoting Odissi and other classical dances. Reviews describe it as a small, clean, peaceful temple serving Mahaprasad. Justdial lists '17 years in business' and year of establishment 2009; no independent source confirms the founding date - flag for verification.

town_description: Noida (New Okhla Industrial Development Authority) is a planned industrial city in Gautam Buddha Nagar district, Uttar Pradesh, part of the Delhi NCR. Known for its wide roads, corporate offices and film city, it has a large resident migrant population including Odia, Bengali and Keralite communities, each with its own community temples.
